title: Veracity labels flip the emotional tone of language models but leave racial disparities intact
abstract: arXiv:2610.33021v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly deliver information through personas, but it is unclear whether correcting the facts also makes their framing consistent across identity labels. We audited four LLMs (GPT-5.4 mini, NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano, Llama 4 Scout, and Claude Haiku 4.5), which rated simulated affect on six dimensions (mood, anger, fear, confidence, perceived control, and mental state) in response to fact-checked false and true headlines presented without and with a veracity label. Experiment 1 evaluated 1,000 false and 1,000 true headlines without personas; Experiment 2 evaluated 300 of each under 12 personas crossing race, gender, and age. translated_title: 真实性标签会翻转语言模型的情感基调，但种族差异依然存在
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLMs）越来越多地通过人设来传递信息，但目前尚不清楚纠正事实是否也能使其在不同身份标签下的表述保持一致。我们审计了四个LLM（GPT-5.4 mini、NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Nano、Llama 4 Scout和Claude Haiku 4.5），它们对经事实核查的虚假和真实标题（分别在不带和带真实性标签的情况下呈现）在六个维度（情绪、愤怒、恐惧、自信、感知控制和心理状态）上的模拟情感进行了评分。实验1在无人设条件下评估了1,000条虚假标题和1,000条真实标题；实验2在跨越种族、性别和年龄的12种人设下对每类300条标题进行了评估。真实性标签强烈改变了情感基调：采用标题聚类自助法推断的有序逻辑回归显示，对于GPT、Llama和Claude而言，反驳虚假标题使评分从以负面为主转变为以正面为主（例如，Claude的“自信”评分从22%上升……）
tldr: 真实性标签能显著翻转语言模型对虚假新闻的负面情感基调，但不同种族人设之间的情感评分差异并未因此消除。
en_tdlr: Veracity labels flip the emotional tone of language models from negative to positive when refuting false headlines, yet racial disparities across personas remain intact.
